head: 0ce0033fd53f93f0d29d16e6fc48f34892c5159b
scope: Read-only core/service audit with an unapplied proposed patch and CPU-only regression probe.

findings.title: Continued checkpoint policy misses valid off-grid frontiers
evidence: ds4.c:76765 invalidates intermediate DS41 checkpoints; final logits validate them at 76784.
server_progress_cb observes 32768-token callback frontiers; interval is 20480, first common frontier 163840.
254896 is not divisible by 20480, so the valid final prompt does not get stored.
Cold saving in ds4_server.c:13707-13711 is limited to prompts <=30000 tokens.
findings.reproduction: policy-results.json: baseline writes=0, invalid_attempts=1; proposed candidate writes=1 at254896, invalid_attempts=0.

findings.title: DeepSeek active state cannot be rewound by dropping token counts
evidence: ds4.c:86956-86959 explains compressor rollback requires a saved frontier.
The repeated request is a shorter prefix of the completed prompt+answer, not an append to that full live state.

findings.title: Post-answer eviction snapshot cannot replace a missing prompt snapshot
evidence: disk-evidence.json: one254972-token evict entry and no254896-token prompt entry.
ds4_kvstore_find_text_prefix correctly rejects stored text longer than the incoming prompt.
Cache usage32.49GiB is below the configured64GiB budget. Increasing capacity alone does not repair the checkpoint schedule.

findings.title: token-mismatch label conflates different tokens with a shorter matching prefix
evidence: common=prompt=254896, old_pos=254972; no mismatching token is required to produce this label.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish shorter-prefix/rollback-unavailable misses from actual token divergence.

changes: Keep the interval grid but accept the first valid live frontier after crossing its next boundary.
Skip continued saves until ds4_session_checkpoint_valid is true.
Never mark an unfinished DS41 checkpoint valid and never truncate a compressed snapshot.
proposal.host_test: PASS with UBSan; existing extracted policy contract cases and recorded frontier sequence.
pending_validation: Apply source patch and build a separate candidate binary.
With authorized service interruption, compare candidate full logits and restore/append behavior at actual near256K.
Verify identical repeated HTTP request loads the prompt checkpoint and retains16/16 recall.
